O.outcome_detail: principal practice rating distribution

cells.quote: Principal practice ratings varied across the possible score range in the pilot year, indicating that the measures have the potential to differentiate performance among principals; however, most principals received ratings of effective or highly effective.
cells.note: Descriptive variation and concentration of ratings; no printed effect size or comparison statistics are reported.

O.outcome_detail: year-to-year stability of school median student growth percentiles

cells.quote: School median student growth percentiles, which measure student achievement growth during the school year, exhibit year-to-year stability even when the school changes principals.
cells.note: The finding indicates stability/association rather than a causal treatment effect; no printed effect size is reported.

O.outcome_detail: school median student growth percentiles

cells.quote: School median student growth percentiles correlate with student disadvantage, a relationship that warrants further investigation using statewide evaluation data.
cells.note: The report's summary states that schoolwide student achievement growth was lower at schools with more disadvantaged students; no printed effect size is reported.

cells.quote: Nearly all principals received effective or highly effective overall ratings. Variation in the overall ratings was limited, with 99 percent of principals rated as effective or highly effective.

O.outcome_detail: percentage receiving highly effective overall ratings

cells.quote: The percentage of principals who received highly effective overall ratings was lower for principals who were evaluated on school median student growth percentiles than for principals who were not evaluated on this measure.

O.outcome_detail: overall and component principal evaluation ratings

cells.quote: Several component measure ratings—school median student growth percentile ratings, teachers’ student growth objective ratings, and principal practice instrument ratings—as well as the overall rating, had low, negative correlations with student socioeconomic disadvantage.

O.outcome_detail: year-to-year stability of school median student growth percentiles

cells.quote: Principal practice instrument ratings and school median student growth percentiles had moderate to high year-to-year stability. But school median student growth percentiles changed more across years in smaller schools than in larger ones.
